# CLM Doc Gen forms: the spec and the product

### Field types and their properties

Common properties [an internal CLM reference: CLM Document Generation Form Specifications]: **Field Name** (label and internal name; the merge tag is built from it by default, and can be edited per field when **Allow Merge Tag Editing** is on [help: task-9489]), **Help Text**, **Default Value**, **Field Value** (where the value comes from), **Required**, **Visible**, **Read Only**, **Allow User to Edit**, **Add Conditions**, **Field Validation**, and the identifiers **Source Identifier**, **Target Identifier**, **Extraction Source ID**.

| Field type | Sources | Type-specific settings [an internal CLM reference: CLM Document Generation Form Specifications] |
|---|---|---|
| Attachment | the CLM repository, the user's computer | any source / computer only / CLM only; required |
| Checkbox | user, Salesforce | selected by default; hidden but still merged |
| Currency | user, Salesforce | dollar sign on/off; decimal places |
| Date | user, Salesforce, the submission date, a fixed date | Word output format; validation against another Date field ("Renewal Date after Effective Date") |
| Dropdown | custom options (at most 50), Salesforce picklist or related object, CLM attribute, CLM multiselect attribute, CSV document | see CSV and multiselect below |
| Heading, Section | none | a Section groups fields, with one level of subsections |
| Library Field | the Forms Library | a reference to a shared field or section; refresh it after the library changes |
| Number | user, Salesforce number or percent | decimal places; percent sign |
| Radio Buttons | custom options, Salesforce picklist, CLM attribute | one choice |
| Table | a Salesforce related list (one-to-many), or a custom table | object, filters, columns, column formats, sorting, first row only, row count |
| Term / SXTerm | an SXTerm document | alternative clauses; option notes; text editable once (changes only the generated document) |
| Text, Text Box | user, Salesforce | short text / long text |
| Users and Groups | a CLM user or group attribute | merges e.g. email, permission profile, title, groups |

**Naming rules** [an internal CLM reference: CLM Document Generation Form Specifications]: a field name has 3–40 characters (conflict: the form editor counts **0 / 200** for a field name and **0 / 1000** for help text [observed: merge tag lab 2026-10-29]), does not start with a digit, and uses letters, digits, commas and question marks; help text has at most 300 characters. Users and Groups fields have their own rules and up to 200 characters. For XML prepopulation, a dropdown's name must **not** end in `Dropdown` or `_Dropdown`: such a node causes an error [help: CLM Workflows guide 2026-06-26, p.75, p.99].

**Editing a merge tag** [help: task-9489]: it lets a tag be more descriptive, follow a naming convention, match an external source's field name (such as a Salesforce field), or differ between two fields with the same name. Keep it short, with no spaces or special characters, which can break template rendering. After an edit:
- every template that uses the form needs the new tag; an old tag prints an inline error, or disappears silently when `Optional="true"`;
- the XML node **is** the tag [observed: merge tag lab 2026-10-29], so every workflow XPath into `Params ▸ TemplateFieldData` (Evaluate an XPath, `GetVariableValue("Params.Params.TemplateFieldData.…")`, Rule and Decision conditions, iterators) must change too, and the Params schema must be imported again from a new run. An XPath that finds no node returns empty, with no error [inferred].

**Custom tables** [an internal CLM reference: CLM Document Generation Form Specifications]: no Salesforce needed. Columns: Checkbox, Currency, Date, Dropdown (custom, CSV, CLM attribute or multiselect attribute), Number, Text Box, Text Field. At most **16 columns** and **100 rows** (also [help: CLM Workflows guide 2026-06-26, p.75]); no conditions on the table or its fields; every row is merged.

**CSV-backed dropdowns** [an internal CLM reference: CLM Document Generation Form Specifications]: the options come from a CSV in CLM; checking in a new version updates them. Over 10 KB the picklist becomes a type-ahead; keep it at 1 MB or less; over 25 MB is not guaranteed.

**Multiselect**: a Dropdown with **Link to Docusign CLM Multiselect Attribute Field** takes several values; the attribute group must hold a Dropdown attribute with one value per line [an internal CLM reference: CLM Document Generation Form Specifications]. In the XML a multiselect column is a `_Wrapper` with one `_SingleValue` per choice (sample below) [help: CLM Workflows guide 2026-06-26, p.100].

### Conditional logic

A condition shows or merges a field when **all**, **any** or **none** of its rules hold [an internal CLM reference: CLM Document Generation Form Specifications]. Rules can test Checkbox, Currency, Date, Dropdown, Number, Radio Button, Term and Text fields, with operators such as is equal to / is not equal to, contains / does not contain, and has a value / does not have a value [an internal CLM reference: CLM Document Generation Form Specifications]. Salesforce conditions are evaluated before the form loads; conditions on other fields are evaluated as the user types [an internal CLM reference: CLM Document Generation Form Specifications]. For stable downstream XML: keep every node in the expected schema, test each combination, and capture the XML of each [an internal CLM reference: CLM Document Generation Form Specifications].

Conflict: the reference lists Dropdown among the fields a condition can use; the guide says conditions on drop-down fields are not supported (in the input XML topic) [help: CLM Workflows guide 2026-06-26, p.75]. Follow the guide: do not rely on a condition on a dropdown in a prepopulated form.

### Compiling a form [observed: 2026-10-29]

`src/clm-docgen-form.ts` turns a spec (`{ id, name, fields: [{ kind, label, tag?, required?, hidden?, readOnly?, default?, decimals?, help?, after?, options?, format?, fields?, columns? }] }`;
kinds `text`, `number`, `currency`, `date`, `checkbox`, `dropdown`, `radio`, `heading`, `attachment`, `section`, `table`) into the form's `Config`
from field templates harvested read-only from the account's own forms (`assets/clm-docgen-forms/field-templates.json`).
The editor page carries its whole view model base64-encoded (UTF-16) in `ctrl.onInit('…')`, which is where they were read.

- **Merge tag:** the label with `_` for each run of other characters; a spec `tag` replaces it and sets `hasCustomMergeTag`; a table's tag `T` gives `T_Container` and rows `T`.
- **Default value, hidden** (with the date format, proven live 2026-11-01, [report](../assets/clm-docgen-forms/verify/service-order-defaults.json)): `default` is stored as the field's
  `SourceIdentifier`, as the account's own forms store "Master Service Agreement" (read-only) and "65,000" (editable)
  [observed: Contract - CREATE, Contract - Lease, _TEMPLATE_]. `hidden` sets `visible: false` (the account's hidden-but-merged
  CSV fields) and `isHidden: true` (the launcher renders it with class `hiddenField`, not visible) [inferred: which of the two keys it reads]; with a `default` the hidden field still
  merges that value. A read-only field with a default shows as text, not an input. A has-a-value / no-value condition stores
  `Parameters: [{ "Name": "ComparisonValue" }]`, as the account's forms do; `[]` never showed the field. A Field Value from the input XML by XPath is NOT compiled: stored as `ExtractionSourceId: "XMLExtractor"` with the XPath as
  `SourceIdentifier`, a text field showed the XPath text itself on the launcher (lab 2026-11-01); fill a field by its merge tag in the input XML. A date's `format` is its `formatString` (the account's forms use `MM/dd/yyyy`). Lab:
  `clm-docgen-config-verify` on [`service-order-defaults`](../assets/clm-docgen-forms/specs/service-order-defaults.json)
  (gates defaults, hiddenMerged, dateFormat; conditions with equals, contains and has a value).
- **Refused:** a tag with spaces or special characters, a duplicate tag, a dropdown tag ending in `dropdown`, more than 50 options, more than 16 table columns.
- **Upload:** `clm-docgen-form-verify.ts` posts the editor's own Save (`viewModel=<json>` to `/clm/Admin/FormConfig/Save` with the page's anti-forgery token; a new form is the view model of `FormConfig?configUid=undefined` with a fresh ConfigUid). It reads the form back, opens it in the editor, checks the Merge Tags tab lists every compiled tag, and deletes it (`/clm/Admin/DocLauncherConfig/DeleteForm`).
- **The dropdown template matters:** a dropdown copied from an account form that was linked to a CLM attribute (`isMetadataField`, `picklistId`, `dynamicOptions`) saved fine but the editor could not open the form afterwards (a system error page). The custom-options dropdown from the merge tag lab works.
- `msa-intake-form` (every kind, a custom tag, a section and a table: 12 merge tags) passed every gate.
- **Fields from CLM** (compiled 2026-11-02 from harvest B3-H1, a ZZ Lab form made in the editor on the lab CLM account): `attributeDropdown` / `attributeMultiselect` (`attribute`: Add Field ▸ Dropdown ▸ 'Link to Docusign CLM (Multiselect) Attribute Field': `isMetadataField`, `metadataFieldName`, `picklistId` and one `Option` child `{ TargetIdentifier: "Id", SourceIdentifier: <attribute uid>, ExtractionSourceId: "AttributeField", type: "Repeating" }`; the multi-select is `MultiSelectPickList` / `multi-select-dropdown` with a `Separator`; the editor fills `dynamicOptions` from the attribute's list), `user` (Users and Groups: `Actor` / `actor`, `metadataFieldName` and `MetadataFieldUid` of a user attribute, only 'Document Owner' offered, `Fields: { FullName, GroupName }`), `term` (`Composite` / `sxterm`, `sxTermUid` = the .sxterm document's uid; a `<tag>_Container` selection holding the term's name, text and notes from `SCMTermDocument` by `?property=name|text|notes`) and `csvDropdown` (`CsvRowChooser`, `SourceIdentifier` = the CSV document's uid, `AccountId`, a `<tag>_Dropdown` text field and a `CsvDocument` section of `record` fields, one per column; `DropdownPossibleValues` names the shown column). The uids are the account's: the spec's `attributeIds` / `termIds` / `csvIds` map names to them (as an eForm spec's `attributeIds`); a name with no uid compiles to `REPLACE:<name>` and `docgenMissingIds` lists it (the verify refuses). The Merge Tags tab lists a term as `<# <RichText Select="//<tag>Text" Optional="true"/> #>` and a CSV dropdown as its column tags; the others as `Content` on their own tag. Proven 2026-11-02 (B4-C2, [report](../assets/clm-docgen-forms/verify/supplier-clm-sources.json)): [`supplier-clm-sources`](../assets/clm-docgen-forms/specs/supplier-clm-sources.json) saved, read back as compiled, opened in the editor and listed every tag. A Form Field Library field is not compiled: the lab CLM account has no library.
- **Text Box** (`kind: "textBox"`): the editor stores it as `objectType: "Html"` (rich text on); harvested from a ZZ form made in the editor. Filled by a workflow's Document Generation step (input XML, no person), it prints raw HTML in the document (`<html><head>…<body>…`, observed 2026-10-31): the solution compiler refuses that; use a text field (`kind: "text"`), which prints clean but drops a line break.
- **Conditions** (`mergeIf: [{ field, op, value }]`, all must hold): the editor's "Merge this field into the template if all of the following conditions are met". It writes `FieldSpecifications` (`If` ▸ `Operator: "And"` ▸ `Operations[]`, each `{ type: "StringEqualsSpecification" …, DataType, Parameters: [{ Name: "ComparisonValue", Parameter }], SourceIdentifier: <source trackId>, ExtractionSourceId: <source tag>, Icon: <source templateId> }`), `specificationType: "FieldSpecifications"` and a plain JSON copy in `FieldSpecificationsJson`. The editor page shows that copy with `}}` as `&#125;&#125;`; saving it that way makes the Doc Launcher form a system error page. Sources: dropdown, radio, checkbox (`"true"`/`"false"`); a text field as source is refused (a "has a value" condition on one never showed its field).
- **What a condition does** [observed]: on the Doc Launcher form the field is not on the page until its condition holds (the inputs that drive one carry class `visibilityTrigger`); when it does not hold, the field has **no node** in `TemplateFieldData` and its tag merges blank. A checkbox comes back as `True`; a date also as `<tag>_unformatted` (ISO).
- **Operators** by source [observed: src/clm-docgen-form.ts:47]: dropdown and radio (`DataType: "Dropdown"`) take `equals`, `notEquals`, `contains`, `notContains`, `hasValue`, `noValue` (`StringEqualsSpecification`, `StringNotEqualsSpecification`, `StringContainsSpecification`, `StringNotContainsSpecification`, `IsNotEmptySpecification`, `IsEmptySpecification`); a checkbox (`DataType: "Checkbox"`) takes `equals` and `notEquals` only.
- **Word template** and **configuration**: see [the next section](#the-generated-word-template-and-the-configuration).
- `captures/clm-docgen-config-verify.ts` proves all of it: form, template, configuration, Doc Launcher opens, conditional fields appear only when their condition holds, generate, the launched run's Params, and the downloaded document's merged text. [`nda-request-conditional`](../assets/clm-docgen-forms/specs/nda-request-conditional.json) passed every gate (2026-10-30).
- **Decimals** (`decimals`, 1–6, number and currency fields; compiled 2026-11-02, live proof queued): `showDecimal: true`, `decimalPlaces` and `customValidatorParameters.decimalPlaces`, the format `#,##0.00`, and `"decimal"` in `validatorParameters` — the shape of the account's own Contract - Lease form. The config verify adds gates `decimals` (the Params value has that many decimals), `readOnly` (a read-only field has no input) and `optionalEmpty` (a field with no value prints blank, no XPath error: `Optional="true"`).
- **Help text** (`help`, 1–300 characters) is `helpText` on the field; **a date after another date** (`after: "<date field label>"`, date fields) is the editor's Field Validation "is after": `ValidationCondition` `{ ValidationConditionType: "DateFieldValidationCondition", ConditionOperation: "DateTimeGreaterThanSpecification", TriggerField: [{ id: "<the other field's trackId>", label }] }` and the same as `ValidationConditionJson` (harvest B3-H1, 2026-11-02; compiled, live proof queued on msa-intake-form). Not offered: a field width (every field stores `ExtraWide`).

### The generated Word template and the configuration

**Word template.** `docgenTemplateDocx(spec, spec.template)` writes a minimal `.docx` (`[Content_Types].xml`,
`_rels/.rels`, `word/document.xml`) [observed: src/clm-docgen-form.ts:189]. Its tags are the compiled form's own
(the same list as the Merge Tags tab), so the template and the form cannot drift:

| Part | What it prints |
|---|---|
| title | the form's name, bold |
| the spec's `template[]` paragraphs | the text, each `{{Label}}` replaced by that field's tag `<# <Content Select="//<tag>" Optional="true"/> #>`; an unknown label is refused |
| each field | `Label: <# <Content Select="//<tag>" Optional="true"/> #>` |
| a section or heading | its label, bold |
| a custom table | `Label:`, then a Word table: a header row of column labels and one row whose first cell starts with `<# <TableRow Select="//<row tag>" /> #>` and whose cells hold `<# <Content Select="./<column tag>" Optional="true"/> #>` |

`Optional="true"` means a field with no value merges blank, which is what a conditional field that does not hold
needs (it has no node in `TemplateFieldData`).

**Configuration** (CLM ▸ Admin ▸ Doc Launcher Configuration). There is no file: the configuration page POSTs
`data=<json>` to `/clm/Admin/DocLauncherConfig/Save`; delete with POST `…/DocLauncherConfig/Delete?uid=`.
`src/clm-docgen-config.ts` writes the body that `captures/clm-docgen-config-verify.ts` proved (2026-10-29/30)
[observed: src/clm-docgen-config.ts:23]. Every uid is the account's:

| Key | Value | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `Uid` | a new uuid | the configuration |
| `AccountId`, `Name` | | |
| `DestinationFolderUid`, `DestinationFolderName` | the account's folder | where generated documents go |
| `Templates[0].XmlTemplateName`, `TemplateConfigUid` | the form's name and uid | the doc-gen form |
| `Templates[0].DocumentTemplateName`, `DocTemplateUid` | the uploaded `.docx`'s name and uid | the Word template |
| `Templates[0].Name`, `SxFormConfigPath` | `<form name> Template`; `/clm/Admin/FormConfig?aid=<aid>&configUid=<form uid>` | |
| `LaunchActions[]` | `[{ FollowupActionType: 1, ActionParameters: <CLM workflow NAME>, Order: 0, WaitForAction: false }]`, or `[]` | the workflow launched after a document is generated. It must exist and be published; it gets the form's XML as `Params`, so a doc-gen start is set here, not in the workflow |
| `LaunchLocation` | `2` | |
| `SalesforceObject`, `SalesforcePath`, `SalesforceName` | `null` | a Salesforce-sourced configuration is not modelled |
| `OutputType`, `DeveloperMode`, `HeadlessMode`, `OneClickDocGen`, `AddDocToClm360`, `EnableTemplateGroups`, `Filters` | `0`, `false`, …, `[]` | as the page saves them |

A solution lists configurations as `clmDocgenConfigs: [{ form, name?, launch?, folder: { path, name?, uid? } }]`;
`deploy-scenario --solution` uploads the `.docx` into the folder, then saves the configuration (the deploy step
mirrors the verify script and was not run live on its own) [observed: docs/SOLUTION-SPEC.md:50; commit 1048b848].

### Generating from a workflow

- **Create or Upload Doc** is a human task: it opens the form (prepopulated by **Input Xml**), with **Name** (the configuration), **Document Template Name** (blank shows the template choice), **Source** (Salesforce or not), **Salesforce Object Type** and **Salesforce Object ID** [help: CLM Workflows guide 2026-06-26, p.74–75].
- **Document Generation** generates without a user: **Document Generation Configuration Name**, **… Template Name**, **Salesforce Object Id**, and either **Update Value(s)** (target identifier = value pairs) or an XML **Variable**. Paths: Success, Conditional Success, Failure [help: CLM Workflows guide 2026-06-26, p.37].
- **XML Merge Document** merges XML data into a template's mail-merge fields [help: CLM Workflows guide 2026-06-26, p.65].

Conflict: the reference describes the user-free, form-backed generation as the **XML Merge Document** step (configuration, template name, input XML, Salesforce object). In the guide those fields belong to **Document Generation** (no user) and **Create or Upload Doc** (with the form). Follow the guide.

### Limits

| Item | Value | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Document generated or uploaded through a configuration | 200 MB; 50 MB or less recommended | [an internal CLM reference: CLM Document Generation Form Specifications] |
| Form size | 256 MB; a bigger form cannot be saved | [an internal CLM reference: CLM Document Generation Form Specifications] |
| Custom table | 16 columns, 100 rows | [help: CLM Workflows guide 2026-06-26, p.75] |
| Custom dropdown options | 50 | [an internal CLM reference: CLM Document Generation Form Specifications] |
| CSV dropdown | type-ahead over 10 KB; ≤1 MB recommended; >25 MB not guaranteed | [an internal CLM reference: CLM Document Generation Form Specifications] |
| Help text / field name | 300 / 3–40 characters (Users and Groups: 200) | [an internal CLM reference: CLM Document Generation Form Specifications] |

When fields do not fill from XML, check [an internal CLM reference: CLM Document Generation Form Specifications]: `ExtractionSourceId` is `XMLExtractor`; `SourceIdentifier` matches the node; the root element is the expected one; the field has no other source; the node exists for the chosen conditional path; the value fits the type. For a table: the container node exists and the columns use relative paths.
